DZA.note: ANIE's central data centre serves the election authority only; no data centre for hire stated.

facts.fact: ANIE's interim president Karim Khelfane said its electronic services portal offers services including registration on and removal from electoral lists, correction of personal data and change of residence.

DZA.note: Document does not say the roll is held in a digital register, nor that voters can check it or that it is linked to ID; it names online registration and a central data centre tracking the revision.
Nothing on local government office connection; communes appear only as revision sites.
Only ANIE's own data centre, not for hire.
